Title: Earthquake Waves
Content: An earthquake occurs when pieces of `text(Earth)`'s crust move, producing waves of energy called seismic waves. `text(Two)` types of seismic waves that travel through `text(Earth)`'s interior are called P-waves and S-waves. P-waves can travel through solids and liquids, but S-waves can only travel through solids.
